subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding profit margin: calculating revenue minus costs, and pricing a product or service to be sustainable
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student calculates cost-per-unit and sets a price that leaves a reasonable profit margin for a simple product
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a price/cost combination to its resulting profit margin
exercise.abstract: Student calculates profit margin for a given price and cost, and adjusts pricing to reach a target margin

misconception_flags: sets a price below total cost, resulting in a loss rather than a profit

interest_binding: business idea generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
